forbid.reason: broad git pre-approves deleting branches, rewriting history and pushing
the same rule as Bash(git *), which pre-approves deleting branches, rewriting history and pushing
git config can set an alias or core.fsmonitor, and either runs any command
git submodule foreach runs any command
git -C <dir> runs any git subcommand, so it pre-approves pushing, deleting branches and rewriting history
broad gh can move origin/main without the push prompt
gh api can write to the remote and move origin/main without the push prompt
broad npm pre-approves npm run deploy; allow named scripts instead
npx runs any package, a deploy tool included
npm run * pre-approves npm run deploy; allow named scripts instead
